import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Identify features: numeric columns excluding targets and identifiers
exclude_cols = {"id", "formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev", "spacegroup"}
feature_cols = [
    col
    for col in train_df.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns
    if col not in exclude_cols
]

X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_form = train_df["formation_energy_ev_natom"].values
y_gap = train_df["bandgap_energy_ev"].values

# Hold-out validation split
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train_df)), test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)
X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
y_form_train, y_form_val = y_form[train_idx], y_form[val_idx]
y_gap_train, y_gap_val = y_gap[train_idx], y_gap[val_idx]


# Define RMSLE metric
def rmsle_metric(y_true, y_pred):
    y_pred = np.clip(y_pred, -0.999, None)
    return np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log1p(y_pred) - np.log1p(y_true)) ** 2))


# Train models
model_form = lgb.LGBMRegressor(verbose=-1)
model_form.fit(X_train, y_form_train)

model_gap = lgb.LGBMRegressor(verbose=-1)
model_gap.fit(X_train, y_gap_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
pred_form_val = model_form.predict(X_val)
pred_gap_val = model_gap.predict(X_val)

score_form = rmsle_metric(y_form_val, pred_form_val)
score_gap = rmsle_metric(y_gap_val, pred_gap_val)
mean_score = np.mean([score_form, score_gap])
print(f"Validation Mean Column-Wise RMSLE: {mean_score:.5f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_X = test_df[feature_cols].values
pred_form_test = model_form.predict(test_X)
pred_gap_test = model_gap.predict(test_X)

# Save submission
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["formation_energy_ev_natom"] = pred_form_test
submission["bandgap_energy_ev"] = pred_gap_test
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
